ideas.pitch: A logic-driven flowchart debugger that translates complex algorithmic code into visual step-by-step execution trees for educational demonstration.
ideas.title: Algoxilla LogicFlow
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targets the Grand Prize by focusing on a polished, working live demo that solves a clear developer friction point within the 12-hour limit.

ideas.pitch: An emergency dispatch simulator that triages incoming emergency calls using text parsing and routes them with real-time logic constraints.
ideas.title: RouteLogic AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Employs the proven high-impact approach of dispatcher systems seen in winning projects, adapted for a rapid 12-hour build.

ideas.pitch: A lightweight machine learning model and dashboard predicting passenger travel satisfaction and experience bottlenecks based on transit logs.
ideas.title: TransitPredict Shinkansen
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly implements predictive data analysis patterns from past winning data science hackathons, ensuring clear, quantitative output for judges.

ideas.pitch: A walk-to-earn and carbon tracking web app tailored for student campuses to gamify eco-friendly commuting choices.
ideas.title: EcoLogix Campus
ideas.why_it_could_win: Features clear measurable impact and a tangible live user interface that judges can test immediately in their browsers.

ideas.pitch: A streamlined web dashboard simulating IoT water quality sensor feeds and forecasting algal bloom risk indices.
ideas.title: AquaLogix Monitor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages predictive modeling with an emphasis on environmental safety, providing a compelling narrative and working prototype.
